Only three changes are recorded for nginx-web-server across the full 24-hour lookback window, and all three land within a ~3-minute span immediately before onset (roughly 16:03:32-16:03:34 on 2026-10-03). All three changes are creations, not modifications: a Service and a ConfigMap (both named for nginx-thrift) created two seconds apart, followed by first creation of the workload container. This is the signature of an initial bring-up of the service rather than a change to an already-running deployment. All three changes share the same actor, platform-automation, so the bring-up was machine-driven with no recorded human operator action in the window. Tight temporal coupling: the container was created approximately three minutes before incident onset, making the service's own first start the most proximate change to the incident.
